coverage_definition.denominator: externally checkable technical, empirical, research, or official-product sentences
coverage_definition.covered: at least one eligible primary source mapped by direct link, concrete-technique mapping, or same paragraph
coverage_definition.direct: sentence-local link or curated concrete-technique primary source
coverage_definition.not_required: normative design instructions, examples, transitions, and structural prose

semantic_validation_boundary: Lean proves ledger consistency, not that a source semantically entails the Japanese sentence.
